questions.question:
By interchanging the given two signs and numbers which of the following equation will be not correct?

× and ÷, 2 and 6

I. 7 – 4 × 3 ÷ 6 + 2 = 8

II. 6 – 8 × 2 + 9 ÷ 3 = 5
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

Interchanging × and ÷, 2 and 6 in the given equation and find which is not correct.

I. 7 – 4 × 3 ÷ 6 + 2 = 8

After interchanging the sign and numbers we get the:

⇒ 7 – __**4 ÷ 3**__ × 2 + 6 = 8

⇒ 7 - __**1.333 × 2**__ + 6 = 8

⇒ __**7**__ - 2.666 __**+ 6**__ = 8

⇒ 13 - 2.666 = 8

⇒ 10.334 ≠ 8 (Not correct)

II. 6 – 8 × 2 + 9 ÷ 3 = 5

After interchanging the sign and numbers we get the:

⇒ 2 – __**8 ÷ 6**__ + 9 × 3 = 5

⇒ 2 - 1.333 + __**9 × 3**__ = 5

⇒ __**2**__ - 1.333 __**+ 27**__ = 5

⇒ 29 - 1.333 = 5

⇒ 27.667 ≠ 5 (Not correct)

So, Both I and II are not correct.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**

questions.question:
After interchanging the given two numbers and two signs what will be the values of equations (I) and (II) respectively?

– and ×, 6 and 4

I. 7 × 6 + 8 ÷ 2 – 4

II. 4 – 7 × 6 + 8 ÷ 2
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

Here in this question interchanging the given two numbers and two signs in the given equation.

**Given: **– and ×, 6 and 4

I. 7 × 6 + 8 ÷ 2 – 4

After interchanging the two numbers and two signs we get the;

⇒ 7 - 4 + __**8 ÷ 2**__ × 6

⇒ 7 - 4 + __**4 × 6**__

⇒ __**7**__ - 4 __**+ 24**__

⇒ 31 - 4 = 27

II. 4 – 7 × 6 + 8 ÷ 2

After interchanging the two numbers and two signs we get the;

⇒ 6 × 7 - 4 + __**8 ÷ 2**__

⇒ __**6 × 7**__ - 4 + 4

⇒ __**42**__ - 4 __**+ 4**__

⇒ 46 - 4 = 42

Hence, the correct answer is **"27, 42".**

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and the fourth number is related to the third number.

7 : 25 :: 4 : 4 :: 3 : ?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

**Logic: (First number - 2)² : Second number.**

1) 7 : 25

⇒ (7 - 2)² ⇒ (5)² ⇒ 25

And,

2) 4 : 4

⇒ (4 - 2)² ⇒ (2)2 ⇒ 4

Similarly,

3) 3 : ?

⇒ (3 - 2)2 ⇒ (1)2 ⇒ 1

Hence, the correct answer is **"1".**

**Option 3) **P × R - Q

Here, P is the Sister of R. (Incorrect)

**Option 4) **P ÷ Q - R

Here, P is the Paternal uncle of R. (Correct)

questions.question:
Read the given statement(s) and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

**Statements:**

Some ships are cups.

No cup is a stool.

All windows are cups.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some ships being windows is a possibility.

II. No window is a stool.

III. All cups are windows.

IV. No ship is a stool.

options.text: Only Conclusions I, II and IV follow
Only Conclusions II and III follow
Only Conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

The least possible Venn diagram is shown below according to the given information.

**Statements:**

Some ships are cups.

No cup is a stool.

All windows are cups.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6723894dd9bbe95b6a7b55f6e128231d69818c3bda4bf5befb0f7e0291707524.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some ships being windows is a possibility → **Follow **→ As some ships are cups and No cup is a stool and all windows are cups. So some ships being windows is a possibility is definitely followed.

II. No window is a stool → **Follow **→ As No cup is a stool and All windows are cups. So No window is a stool is definitely followed.

III. All cups are windows → Does not follow → As all windows are cups. So all cups are windows is not definitely followed.

IV. No ship is a stool → **Does not follow **→ As some ships are cups and No cup is a stool and all windows are cups. So No ship is a stool is not followed because it is a possibility that some ships are stool. So it is definitely not followed.

So, the only conclusions I and II follow.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
